info.name: transcript-api
info.description:
Every endpoint of the YouTube Transcript API (FastAPI): auth, invitations,
admin, transcripts, agent sessions, documents, settings, cross-chat, and the
playlist manager (YouTube auth, playlists, watch history, plans).

1. Import this collection **and** `transcript-api.postman_environment.json`,
   then select the environment.
2. Set `email` / `password` to a local account (an admin for the Admin folder).
3. Send **Auth -> Login** -- `access_token` and `refresh_token` fill in
   automatically.

Requests marked **[LIVE]** call YouTube/Google or a paid LLM API and are
skipped unless `allow_live` is `"true"`. Requests whose ids aren't set yet
are skipped too. Full guide: `postman/README.md`.

item.name: Auth
item.description:
**Run Login first.** Its test script copies `access_token` and `refresh_token`
from the response into the active environment; every other request
authenticates with the collection-level `Bearer {{access_token}}`.

- Access tokens last 15 minutes by default (`ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES`).
  When requests start returning 401, send **Refresh Tokens** (rotates *both*
  tokens) or **Login** again.
- All auth bodies are JSON, not OAuth2 form-data.
- Registration is invite-only by default, so this folder mints an invitation
  (**Invite a New User**) right before **Register**.
- **Logout** is last: it revokes `refresh_token`. The access token stays valid
  until it expires, so later folders in the same run still authenticate.

item.name: Transcripts
item.description:

OpenAI Whisper + embeddings), so it's skipped unless `allow_live` is `"true"`.

Get and Delete need `transcript_id` -- set by Extract, or paste the id of a
transcript you already have. Delete clears it, which also skips the Agent,
Documents and Cross-Chat folders until you set it again.

item.name: Agent
item.description:
Chat with one transcript. **Needs `transcript_id`** pointing at an existing
transcript (Transcripts -> Extract, or paste one of yours).

Everything that creates a session or asks a question is **LIVE**: sessions
index the transcript (OpenAI embeddings) and queries call the LLM (and Tavily
web search when enabled). Those requests are skipped unless `allow_live` is
`"true"`; the requests that need their ids are then skipped too.

The two sessions also feed the Documents and Cross-Chat folders -- to use
them, run those folders *before* this folder's two Delete requests.

The OAuth flow runs in a **browser**, not Postman: send Get Connect URL, open

item.name: Playlists
item.description:
The local playlist cache. Not covered by DOCUMENTATION/API_Reference.md.

**Sync is LIVE** and spends YouTube Data API quota. List Playlists fills
`playlist_id`, `target_playlist_id` and `youtube_playlist_id` from the first two
cached playlists -- only when they're empty, so ids you set by hand win.
Clear them to re-pick.

item.name: Plans
item.description:
Plan -> review -> apply. Not covered by DOCUMENTATION/API_Reference.md.

**Creating a plan is a dry run** -- it never changes YouTube. These kinds are
generated locally: `create`, `dedupe`, `purge_unavailable` (mode `deleted`, no
enrich), `purge_watched`, `move`, `reorder`, and `add_url` with individual video
URLs. The **LIVE** ones read from YouTube: `purge_unavailable` with
`mode: deleted_and_private` or `enrich: true`, `copy`, and `add_url` with a
playlist (`list=`) URL, which syncs an uncached source on demand.

**Apply is LIVE**: it edits real playlists and spends the shared daily quota
(default budget 200 units = four writes). Check Playlists -> Get Quota Status
(or `/quota-budget-check` in Claude Code) first.

Every Create request sets `plan_id`, and Get Plan / Apply Plan use it -- so
Apply runs the **last plan created**. In folder order that's the `create`
plan (one new, empty, private playlist).

Most kinds need `playlist_id` (and `move` needs `target_playlist_id`) -- see
Playlists -> List Playlists.
